properties.title: Independent review of the final browser corrections: unchanged expectations; fixture IDs remove duplicate-label ambiguity, mounted geometry is measured after ow

rows.text: Independent review of the final browser corrections: unchanged expectations; fixture IDs remove duplicate-label ambiguity, mounted geometry is measured after owner reads, and Ctrl stays pressed until zoom is observed. Drag, annotation layout and hidden viewport pass 3/3 each; zoom and buildspace channels pass 2/2 each.

Repeated-component recording matched both distinct values, but a pending intercepted read failed during test teardown. Waiting for route handlers fixes that fixture lifecycle; repeated-component test now passes 3/3. No errors are suppressed and no assertions are removed.

The previous whole-browser run had 235/241 passes. Every failing case now passes focused revalidation; the required full test:all checkpoint is running again. Migration-completeness review stays pending that result.
